extracted.name: Creamy Poppy Seed Chicken
extracted.description: This poppy seed chicken recipe bakes cooked chicken in a creamy sauce with a buttery crumb topping for a deliciously tasty way to use leftover chicken.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place chicken in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Combine condensed soup and sour cream in a medium bowl; pour over chicken.
Stir crushed crackers, melted butter, and poppy seeds together in a separate bowl; sprinkle over chicken and sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is browned and sauce is bubbly, about 30 minutes.
